text:
sanjay: quick smoke: ran AWQ vs GPTQ with prefetch + continuous batching on llm-13b (replica infra). seeing a fidelity delta when prefetch is enabled + cbatch=16. uploading notes.

maya: can you drop the run config + exact metrics? short is fine.

sanjay: experiment config:
```
model: llm-13b
quant: awq
continuous_batching: true
cbatch_max_size: 16
prefetch: true
prefetch_ttl_ms: 500
kv_cache_policy: prefix_only
requests: eval-ltr-1k.json
seed: 42
```

sanjay: metrics (eval-ltr-1k, short EM-like metric we use):
- AWQ prefetch ON + cbatch=16: accuracy=78.1%
- AWQ prefetch OFF + cbatch=16: accuracy=80.4%
- GPTQ prefetch ON + cbatch=16: accuracy=80.2%
- GPTQ prefetch OFF + cbatch=16: accuracy=80.6%
notes: AWQ loses ~2.3 pts with prefetch on; GPTQ stable.

liam: interesting. did you try toggling continuous batching off (i.e., force single-request batches)?

sanjay: quick runs: cbatch=1 (no continuous coalescing) -> AWQ prefetch ON: 80.2% (back to baseline). so degradation only when cbatch>1 + prefetch.

olivia: hypothesis: quantization changes key/hash distribution for KV attention, combined with prefetch grabbing prefix KVs from other requests leads to stale/incorrect cache hits when batches are coalesced. AWQ's weight layout might increase "false positive" k-match.

maya: can you paste a short trace snippet showing cache hits/misses around a regression example? even a minimal log helps.

sanjay: pasted minimal trace:```
[2026-03-18T14:23:01Z] req=abcd kv_prefetch: key_bucket=0x7f2 hit=false
[2026-03-18T14:23:01Z] req=efgh kv_prefetch: key_bucket=0x7f2 hit=true (from req=ijkl)
[2026-03-18T14:23:01Z] cbatch_coalesce: merged(reqs=3)
[2026-03-18T14:23:01Z] decode: top_token_diff=0.32 -> argmin shift
```

liam: that looks like a bucket aliasing issue. do we track per-request cache tags when prefetching? if not, hits could be from different contexts.

olivia: we do tag prefetched KVs with source_request_id but our coalescer currently ignores tag mismatch when serving from the common buffer under cbatch. older design assumption: k/v identity invariant across quant schemes — seems violated by AWQ.

maya: quick experiments to validate: 1) enable strict tag-checking to prevent cross-request cache hits 2) add a small salt/hash to key computation (prefix-salt) 3) run with prefetch_ttl_ms=50 (tiny) to see if staleness window matters.

sanjay: running the three now. ETA ~20m for 1k eval. will post results.

ci-bot: New artifact uploaded: s3://bench-artifacts/1734567890/awq-prefetch-cbatches-smoke.tar.gz :eyes:

sanjay: preliminary results:
- strict-tagging ON + prefetch + cbatch=16: AWQ accuracy=80.3% (regression resolved)
- add salt=rand16: AWQ accuracy=80.5%
- prefetch_ttl_ms=50: AWQ accuracy=79.7% (partial improvement)
notes: strict-tagging fixes majority of cases -> suggests cross-request cache contamination.

liam: nice repro. follow-ups: add unit test for kv tag isolation, and a perf sweep to ensure strict-tagging doesn't kill hit-rate in benign patterns.

olivia: also file for model-onboarding note: AWQ requires stricter KV identity checks when using prefetch+coalescing. add to onboarding checklist: run prefetch+batching smoke with strict-tagging toggle.

maya: I'll add the checklist item + a small reproducible harness.

sanjay: thanks. next steps: add fix (strict-tagging default for AWQ models), run full eval (5k queries) and open a short PR with tests. will CC eng-runtime + eng-ml on PR.

liam: 👍

olivia: :thumbsup:
